subject: AWS Marketplace Private Offer — buyer eligibility, term, and PSA credit routing
messages:
From: AcmeCorp Procurement <procurement@acmecorp.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Singh <priya.singh@acmecorp.com>
Date: 2027-12-04T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Private Offer options + PSA credits

Hi Sofia,

Thanks for the convo yesterday — following up from AcmeCorp procurement. We are evaluating a private offer for Redwood Inference and need to confirm a few items before we move to legal/IT:

- Term lengths supported for private offers (1y/3y/5y?) and auto-renew rules
- Whether the buyer (AcmeCorp) needs specific authorization levels in AWS Marketplace to accept the PO
- If and how Professional Services Agreement (PSA) credits / Consulting credits can be routed via the Marketplace PO so we can offset project spend

Attached is a short procurement checklist from our side (procurement_requirements.pdf). Can you confirm the workflow and any documentation we should share with our legal and finance teams? Also please advise an expected timeline to finalize terms once we supply the PO.

Best,
Priya Singh
Head of Procurement, AcmeCorp
attachment: procurement_requirements.pdf (pdf)

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
To: AcmeCorp Procurement <procurement@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-12-04T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Private Offer options + PSA credits

Hi Priya — thanks for the clear list. Quick answers up front, then a proposed next steps list: 

- Term lengths: we support 12, 36, and 60 month private offers. Auto-renew can be enabled but is optional — most customers pick 12 or 36 with manual renewal.
- Buyer eligibility: the Acme procurement account needs to be an active AWS buyer account in good standing; we can share a short buyer checklist for your IT/Marketplace admin to confirm.
- PSA credits routing: we can include a line item on the private offer and surface metadata, but routing credits (to be consumed by a services partner) generally requires coordination with AWS Marketplace team to ensure credits are applied against invoices.

Proposed next steps: 
1) We (Redwood) will draft a private-offer PO template and include a placeholder line item for PSA credits. (I can attach a draft PO.)
2) Ben (cc'd) will coordinate with AWS PM to confirm the technical routing for credits and any marketplace metadata required.
3) Acme to confirm internal approval matrix and target sign date.

I attached a short approval matrix template (Approval_Matrix.xlsx) that helps map buyer sign-off. If you can complete and return by EOD Monday, we can start the PO draft and loop AWS.

Happy to jump on a 20-min call if helpful.

Best,
Sofia Ivanova
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
attachment: Approval_Matrix.xlsx (xlsx)

Subject: Request: AWS confirm buyer eligibility + PSA credit routing (AcmeCorp)

Jake — looping you in to confirm two items for a private-offer we are configuring with AcmeCorp:

1) Buyer eligibility: what exact marketplace flags/permissions does AcmeCorp need to accept a private offer? Their procurement team asked for a short checklist we can pass to their IT admin.
2) PSA credit routing: we want to include a PSA credit line on the PO and have credits applied/allocated to a partner/service line. Can Marketplace support this via PO metadata/invoice mapping, or do we need an AWS PM escalation?

Attachment: a filled Approval_Matrix from the Acme team (they'll return shortly) and a sample PO template we intend to use.

Timeline: Acme would like confirmation this week so they can route internal approvals and return a signed PO next week.

Thanks — Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
attachment: Acme_PO_Sample.pdf (pdf); Approval_Matrix.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Jake Turner <jake.turner@amazon.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@acmecorp.com
Date: 2027-12-06T08:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: AWS confirm buyer eligibility + PSA credit routing (AcmeCorp)

Hi Ben / Sofia — thanks for the details. Short answers: 

- Buyer eligibility checklist: buyer must have an active AWS account in good standing, valid billing agreement, and the Marketplace Admin role enabled (we'll send a one-page checklist). If the buyer is using consolidated billing, confirm the payer account is the one approving the PO.

- PSA credit routing: Marketplace supports invoice-level metadata and optional line-item descriptions, but applying credits to a services partner typically requires that the Seller (Redwood) and the buyer coordinate with Marketplace PMs to set up credit consumption rules. I'll open an internal case with the Marketplace Private Offers team and cc the co-sell manager; expect an initial response within 2 business days and a resolution plan within 3-5 business days.

Notes on term and workflows: private offers with 36- or 60-month terms are allowed; multi-year discounts or rate cards should be documented in the offer metadata. Auto-renew settings are controlled on the buyer side at acceptance.

I'll follow up with the checklist and case number.

Best,
Jake Turner
AWS Marketplace Program Manager
attachment: AWS_marketplace_buyer_checklist.pdf (pdf)
